milestone: Alpha 1.72 ability movement and forced-displacement authority

baseline.ordinaryDispatch: A real match plus normal PerformAbility reproduced Teleport's east-boundary cast/landing at x31 beyond the existing x24 center limit. Charge variants likewise published out-of-bounds destinations; Rogue behind-target movement escaped arena corners; Gravity Well displaced edge opponents beyond the existing floor.
baseline.fixtureCorrections: Initial fixtures included opening invulnerability, expected Momentum's 8-unit aim to extend to14 rather than the actual +50%=12, and expected base Shadow Lunge to deal an immediate hit instead of a bleed. Corrected these assertions while preserving boundary checks, resource/cooldown checks, exact ordinary endpoints, and Lunge's actual wound/source contract. No runtime change to these mechanics.
baseline.raceFinding: First broader race run exposed legacy TestRogueBackstabShadowstep_ClampsInsideDungeon calling the internal world-locked handler without its required lock. A lethal cast's asynchronous loot insertion raced cast event publication. The fixture now uses normal PerformAbility with Backstab unlocked; production dispatch already owns the world lock. No race suppression or weakening of geometry checks.

changes: Shared ability/jump displacement destination helper applies the actual PvP match's existing +/-24 X and +/-16 Z center bounds, just like network walking/jumping. A forged scene prefix does not count as a real match.
This clips Wizard Teleport, Fighter Charge/Momentum/Shattering/Juggernaut, Rogue Shadow Strike/Lunge/Shadowstep and Charge Shockwave before movement or replicated destinations can escape.
Gravity Well and Black Hole pulls independently clip the resulting opponent position to the same match bounds before grounding and spatial-grid update.
Existing actor-to-PvP combat lock order is retained; no new worker, mutable geometry cache or scene-access grant.

Normal quick-jump range versus distance-scaled flight remains an explicit open policy choice; arbitrary distant quick jumps are not declared safe by this arena fix.
